plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Port local par lequel Jeedom transmet se: The local port Jeedom uses to pass orders to the daemon. Change it only if that port is already taken on this machine.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Le portier envoie un signe de vie à cet: The door station sends a sign of life at this interval. Without it, a network loss would be indistinguishable from a day with no visitor: the plugin would stay silent believing it was listening.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Attente avant de retenter après une coup: Wait before retrying after a loss. The delay doubles on each consecutive failure, so as not to hammer a door station that is powered off.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.La photo est prise par le démon au momen: The picture is taken by the daemon at the very moment of the ring, before any scenario wakes up: that is the only way to catch the visitor still in front of the lens.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Nombre de photos gardées par portier. Au: How many pictures are kept per door station. Beyond that, the oldest are deleted.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Décoché, la commande « Ouvrir la porte »: Unticked, the "Open the door" command refuses to run, even when called from a scenario. The command is also created invisible: opening your front door should not be within reach of a stray click.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Identifiant inscrit dans le journal d'ac: The id written to the door station access log for unlocks coming from Jeedom. It lets you tell them apart from a card or a keypad code.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Combien de temps la commande « Sonnerie: How long the "Doorbell" command stays at 1. The door station announces the press, never its end: the plugin is what brings the command back to zero, otherwise it would stay there and no scenario would fire again.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Une ouverture par badge ou par code ne f: A card or keypad unlock does not ring the door station: without this picture, nothing in Jeedom says who just came in.

plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Aucun portier pour le moment. Pour démar: No door station yet. To get started:
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Relevez l'adresse IP du portier et réser: Find the door station's IP address and reserve it in your router. If it changes, the plugin will find nothing and will not be able to say why.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Cliquez sur « Ajouter un portier », donn: Click "Add a door station", give it a name, then enter its address and the credentials of its web interface.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Utilisez « Tester la connexion » : le pl: Use "Test connection": the plugin shows the door station's model and firmware version. Commands are created on save, and the daemon starts listening for calls.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Le plugin parle directement au portier s: The plugin talks straight to the door station on your local network: no recorder, no cloud, no manufacturer account. This plugin is not affiliated with Dahua.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Adresse IP ou nom d'hôte du portier. Rés: IP address or host name of the door station. Reserve it in your router.
The account of the door station web interface.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Il est conservé tel quel dans la base de: It is kept as is in the Jeedom database: the door station only accepts Digest authentication, which needs the plain password on every request.
How the daemon listens for events. On automatic it tries one protocol then falls back to the other. Pin it only if you know which one works for you.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Les valeurs d'usine conviennent à la qua: The factory values suit almost every door station. The DHIP port of a door station is 5000, not 37777 as on a recorder.
1 unless the door station has several cameras.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Les événements tels que le portier les a: Events exactly as the door station sent them, before any interpretation. This is where you see what actually arrives when someone rings — codes vary between models and firmware versions. Leave this page open and ring: the list fills by itself.
